biomarkers.title: Alcohol biomarkers: PEth, EtG, CDT, GGT and MCV detection windows
biomarkers.description: How long PEth, urine EtG, CDT, GGT and MCV stay raised after drinking stops, their accuracy and false positives, and the AST:ALT ratio.

body.title: Alcohol and cancer, heart and brain risk, and the J-curve
body.description: Organ-by-organ relative risks as daily alcohol rises: seven cancers, atrial fibrillation, blood pressure, pancreas, brain, and why the J-curve fails.

brain.title: Alcohol and the brain: GABA, glutamate, tolerance and craving
brain.description: How alcohol boosts GABA and blocks NMDA, why tolerance and withdrawal follow, and the Koob and Volkow addiction cycle, animated and cited.

ciwa.title: CIWA-Ar score: the 10 items and symptom-triggered care
ciwa.description: A teaching CIWA-Ar calculator (0–67) with ASAM 2020 bands, Saitz 1994 symptom-triggered vs fixed dosing animated, and when the scale doesn't fit.

criteria.title: DSM-5-TR alcohol use disorder criteria and severity
criteria.description: The 11 DSM-5-TR criteria for alcohol use disorder, mild to severe, early and sustained remission, the DSM-IV change and ICD-11 compared.

detox.title: Alcohol withdrawal management: setting, benzodiazepines, thiamine
detox.description: How ASAM 2020 manages alcohol withdrawal: risk assessment, outpatient vs inpatient care, symptom-triggered benzodiazepines, phenobarbital and next steps.

drinks.title: Standard drinks and blood alcohol: BAC curve and units
drinks.description: How many grams are in a drink, why blood alcohol falls in a straight zero-order line, how ADH and ALDH make acetaldehyde, plus teaching calculators.

families.title: Alcohol use disorder and families: CRAFT, Al-Anon and what to say
families.description: Support for families of people with alcohol use disorder: CRAFT vs Al-Anon vs confrontation, effects on children, person-first language and safety tips.

frontier.title: Alcohol use disorder research: GLP-1, psilocybin, ketamine
frontier.description: Treatments under study for alcohol use disorder on a pipeline board: semaglutide, psilocybin, ketamine, deep TMS, mifepristone, with evidence labels.

genes.title: Alcohol use disorder genetics: heritability, ALDH2, ADH1B
genes.description: Why about half of AUD risk is heritable, how ALDH2*2 flushing links to oesophageal cancer, what genome scans found, and why risk is not destiny.

glossary.title: Alcohol use disorder glossary: 150 terms from AUDIT to Wernicke
glossary.description: A searchable glossary of alcohol use disorder terms, from acetaldehyde, PEth and CIWA-Ar to the Lille model and CRAFT, each defined, cited and linked.

history.title: History of alcohol use disorder: from Rush and Huss to DSM-5
history.description: Timeline of alcohol use disorder from Benjamin Rush (1784) and Huss to AA, disulfiram, the dependence syndrome, DSM-IV, DSM-5, ICD-11 and today's medicines.

liver.title: Alcohol-associated liver disease: fatty liver to cirrhosis
liver.description: Animated stages of alcohol liver disease from steatosis to cirrhosis, a Maddrey and Lille teaching calculator, STOPAH and early transplant trials.

medicines.title: Naltrexone, acamprosate and disulfiram for AUD: how they work
medicines.description: How naltrexone, acamprosate and disulfiram work, animated, with NNTs from two meta-analyses, the COMBINE trial and label warnings on opioids and the liver.

nursing.title: Alcohol use disorder nursing care: CIWA-Ar and thiamine
nursing.description: A 72-hour admission animated: AUDIT-C and PAWSS screening, CIWA-Ar checks, thiamine, seizure and delirium care, discharge linkage, priority questions.

offlabel.title: Topiramate, gabapentin, baclofen for alcohol use disorder
offlabel.description: Topiramate, gabapentin, baclofen, nalmefene, sodium oxybate and others for alcohol use disorder: trial results, evidence labels and approval status by country.

pregnancy.title: Alcohol in pregnancy and FASD: criteria, prevalence and support
pregnancy.description: No known safe amount in pregnancy: a 40-week animation, FAS facial criteria (Hoyme 2016), FASD prevalence arrays, breastfeeding guidance and support.

quiz.title: Alcohol use disorder quiz: 97 questions with cited answers
quiz.description: Test yourself on alcohol use disorder: screening, DSM-5-TR criteria, withdrawal, Wernicke, medicines, recovery and liver harm, each answer cited.

recovery.title: Alcohol use disorder recovery: course, relapse and levels of care
recovery.description: How drinking changes over 20 years in 100 people with AUD (NESARC), lapse versus relapse, median two recovery attempts, and levels of care explained.

review.title: Alcohol use disorder flashcards and memory aids for revision
review.description: 88 cited flashcards on alcohol use disorder, from AUDIT-C and DSM-5-TR criteria to CIWA-Ar, thiamine and naltrexone, plus memory aids and a withdrawal clock.

screening.title: AUDIT and AUDIT-C alcohol screening: zones, cut-offs and SBIRT
screening.description: Score a teaching AUDIT (0–40) with WHO zones and AUDIT-C cut-offs, follow the SBIRT pathway, and compare screening tools on 100 people.

sources.title: Alcohol use disorder sources: guidelines, trials and drug labels
sources.description: Every reference behind the AUD Companion: journal articles, guidelines, FDA labels and trial registrations, each checked against PubMed or other databases.

therapy.title: Alcohol use disorder therapy: brief advice, CBT, MI, AA
therapy.description: Animated guide to talking treatments for alcohol use disorder: brief intervention, MI, CBT, contingency management, AA and SMART, with Cochrane effect sizes.

wernicke.title: Wernicke encephalopathy and Korsakoff: thiamine and triad
wernicke.description: Why heavy drinking drains thiamine, why the Wernicke triad is often absent, the Caine 2-of-4 criteria, published thiamine regimens and Korsakoff memory loss.

what.title: What is alcohol use disorder? Prevalence and treatment gap
what.description: Alcohol use disorder explained: how common it is (13.9% of US adults a year, 29.1% lifetime), mild to severe, who it affects, the treatment gap and stigma.

withdrawal.title: Alcohol withdrawal timeline: seizures and delirium tremens
withdrawal.description: Hour by hour from the last drink: tremor at 6–24 h, hallucinosis, seizures peaking near 24 h, DTs at 48–96 h, kindling and the PAWSS risk scale. Cited.
